stories.headline: President Prabowo conducts Eid prayers in Aceh with flood victims and disaster survivors
stories.summary: President Prabowo Subianto performed Eid prayers at Darussalam Mosque in Aceh Tamiang alongside around 1,300 flood survivors and disaster victims. He praised recovery efforts, visited temporary housing, and distributed aid packages before returning to Jakarta for palace open house.

stories.headline: Prabowo gives Bloomberg interview criticizing Iran war and discussing budget deficit flexibility
stories.summary: In an exclusive Bloomberg interview from his Hambalang residence, President Prabowo called the US-Israel war on Iran irrational and lacking rationality. He also stated he would only consider breaching Indonesia's 3% budget deficit cap during crisis situations, emphasizing fiscal discipline while remaining open to emergency measures.

stories.headline: Four TNI intelligence officers arrested for acid attack on human rights activist
stories.summary: Military Police (Puspom TNI) announced the arrest of four Indonesian military intelligence (BAIS TNI) officers suspected of throwing acid at KontraS activist Andrie Yunus. The attack occurred after Yunus criticized military remilitarization and TNI laws. Investigations continue into possible command structure involvement and motives.

stories.headline: Two Pertamina oil tankers remain stuck in Hormuz Strait amid Middle East conflict
stories.summary: Two Pertamina tanker ships, Pertamina Pride and Gamsunoro, remain trapped in the Strait of Hormuz due to the Iran-US conflict. Indonesian diplomats are negotiating with Iranian authorities for their release, with Energy Minister Bahlil saying the process faces long queues as multiple countries' vessels are affected.
